description: Check an MCP server's tool definitions without contacting it (undeployed, stdio, CI). Input: a tools/list answer (JSON-RPC or its result), an array of tools, one tool, or a manifest with name/description; input_shape says which was read. Every tool is checked against the MCP spec (name 1-128 chars of A-Z a-z 0-9 _ - .; inputSchema of type object; required fields in properties; camelCase and parameterless tools are valid) and, with strict, documentation (description ≥ 20 chars, every parameter typed and described). verdict: FAIL when a tool breaks a rule or none is found, WARN when only a manifest's name/description is missing, else PASS; a tools/list has no server name (it comes from initialize), so those checks are not scored. Gate on verdict or checks[tool_quality].pass.

examples.manifest: {"tools":[{"name":"get_weather","description":"Return the current weather for a city. Use it when the user asks about the weather now.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","required":["city"],"properties":{"city":{"type":"string","description":"City name, e.g. Paris"}}}}]}

manifest.description: JSON text: the answer to tools/list (raw JSON-RPC or its result), an array of tools, one tool definition, or a manifest with name/description/tools.

strict.description: Also require documentation: every description ≥ 20 characters, every parameter with a description and a type.

name: mcp_server_health_check
